file_roles.evidence: dict_table_rename_in_cache now passes dict_table_is_discarded(table) as if_exists to fil_delete_tablespace, only to suppress the missing-tablespace error.
fil_delete_tablespace wraps the 'Cannot delete tablespace ... not found' ib::error in 'if (!if_exists)'; a log change only.
Updates the fil_delete_tablespace declaration and comment (drop_ahi removed, if_exists added) plus a copyright year.
Removes the row_make_new_pathname declaration because the function becomes static.

row_rename_table_for_mysql now does 'else if (char* old_path = fil_space_get_first_path(...))' and skips when NULL; the old code called row_make_new_pathname unconditionally and crashed for a discarded tablespace. Also relaxes ut_a(table->data_dir_path) in drop.

rationale: The segfault is in row_make_new_pathname, called from row_rename_table_for_mysql with a table whose tablespace was discarded. The caller is changed to skip when there is no path, and the drop path stops asserting. The remaining files are message suppression and declarations.
notes: row_make_new_pathname itself is not corrected, only hidden; the caller owns the missing check.
